Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِيْ فِيْهِ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَالْاَقْذَارِ
Translation: O Allah, purify me in it (this month) from filth and impurities
And grant me patience in it over whatever is destined
And grant me success in it towards piety and the company of the righteous
By Your assistance, O comfort of the eyes of the needy
